summary: Updates release validation to retry temporary evidence-read failures and track impact assessments by merged PR.

api.assessment: Only CI release validation, release-draft tooling and author instructions change. Every source PR still needs an accurate impact entry. Transient reads receive bounded retries; writes, authentication failures and missing or incomplete evidence retain failure handling. Application endpoints, authorization, permissions, scopes, returned links, pagination, downloads, storage policy and runtime feature flags are unchanged.

rollout: Takes effect when workflows use the updated pin on their branch. Application deployment, infrastructure application, SDK publication and App Store availability are not established by this tooling update.
data_effect: Existing customer data, saved processing results and newly computed application outputs are unchanged. No customer migration, rerun or refit is required.

developer_notice.reason: Internal release-validation reliability and authoring policy; no integration or customer action.
